finalText:
Found it in `src/services/pricing.js`. Flat coupons are stored in USD, but the code was subtracting them from the total *after* it was already converted to the target currency — so a $10 coupon became "10 euros off" instead of "10 dollars off."

Fixed it to subtract the flat amount in USD first, then convert. Percent coupons were already fine since a percentage doesn't care about currency.

All 5 tests pass now, in 70ms.
